bounds.rule: History entry heap plus entry-vector capacity and the active scene heap share the budget when the active scene itself fits. An oversized/unknown active scene clears history without dropping or refusing active geometry. All existing cache-key dependencies remain exact.
bounds.counting: SpatialHitIndex counts region/order/tree-node capacities, shape-vector capacities, layer strings and caller-supplied target payload. Current authored-object targets are supported; unknown target kinds return None and bypass retention. Shared Arc geometry is charged in full per entry, conservatively; this is not unique global ownership accounting.
bounds.scope: Heap payload excludes inline top-level owners, allocator and Arc control-block overhead, construction scratch, renderer-held references and companion schematic ownership outside Main history. No complete 64 MiB document/process ceiling is claimed. Construction can coexist with old history until the new payload is known.
bounds.release: Oldest entries are removed under entry/byte pressure; restored entries transfer to active ownership; clear drops entry-vector capacity as well as entries. Authoritative model/session data is never evicted.
